{{Short description|None}}
The '''2022–23 UEFA Europa League group stage''' began on 8 September 2022 and ended on 3 November 2022. A total of 32 teams competed in the group stage to decide 16 of the 24 places in the [[2022–23 UEFA Europa League knockout phase|knockout phase]] of the [[2022–23 UEFA Europa League]].

[[FK Bodø/Glimt|Bodø/Glimt]], [[FC Nantes|Nantes]], [[1. FC Union Berlin|Union Berlin]] and [[Royale Union Saint-Gilloise|Union Saint-Gilloise]] made their debut appearances in the Europa League group stage. Union Saint-Gilloise made their debut appearance in a UEFA competition group stage.

A total of 23 national associations were represented in the group stage.

== Draw ==
The draw for the group stage was held on 26 August 2022 in [[Istanbul]], Turkey. The 32 teams were drawn into eight groups of four. For the draw, the teams were seeded into four pots, each of eight teams, based on their 2022 [[UEFA coefficient#Men's club coefficient|UEFA club coefficients]].<ref name="club coefficients"/> Teams from the same association could not be drawn into the same group. Prior to the draw, UEFA formed pairings of teams from the same association, including those playing in the [[2022–23 UEFA Europa Conference League group stage|Europa Conference League group stage]] (one pairing for associations with two or three teams, two pairings for associations with four or five teams), based on television audiences, where one team was drawn into Groups A–D and another team was drawn into Groups E–H, so that the two teams would have different kick-off times. The following pairings were announced by UEFA after the group stage teams were confirmed (the second team in a pairing marked by UECL played in the Europa Conference League group stage):<ref name="pots">{{cite web|url=https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuropaleague/news/0278-15f5061906ad-73e1628e59d4-1000--group-stage-draw-pots/|title=Europa League group stage draw pots confirmed|website=[[UEFA]] |publisher=Union of European Football Associations|date=26 August 2022}}</ref>

==Teams==
Below were the participating teams (with their 2022 [[UEFA coefficient#Men's Club coefficient|UEFA club coefficients]]),<ref name="club coefficients">{{cite web |url=https://www.uefa.com/nationalassociations/uefarankings/club/#/yr/2022 |title=Club coefficients |website=[[UEFA]] |publisher=Union of European Football Associations |date=31 May 2022 |access-date=9 June 2022}}</ref> grouped by their seeding pot.<ref name="pots"/> They included:

*4 League Path losers of the [[2022–23 UEFA Champions League qualifying phase and play-off round#Third qualifying round|third qualifying round]]

==Format==
In each group, teams played against each other home-and-away in a [[Round-robin tournament|round-robin format]]. The winners of each group advanced to the [[2022–23 UEFA Europa League knockout phase#Round of 16|round of 16]], while the runners-up advanced to the [[2022–23 UEFA Europa League knockout phase#Knockout round play-offs|knockout round play-offs]]. The third-placed teams were transferred to the [[2022–23 UEFA Europa Conference League knockout phase#Knockout round play-offs|Europa Conference League knockout round play-offs]], while the fourth-placed teams were eliminated from European competitions for the season.

===Tiebreakers===
Teams were ranked according to [[Points (association football)|points]] (3 points for a win, 1 point for a draw, 0 points for a loss). If two or more teams were tied on points, the following tiebreaking criteria were applied, in the order given, to determine the rankings (see Article 16 Equality of points – group stage, Regulations of the UEFA Europa League):<ref name="regulations">{{cite web |url=https://documents.uefa.com/r/Regulations-of-the-UEFA-Europa-League-2022/23-Online |title=Regulations of the UEFA Europa League, 2022/23 Season |website=[[UEFA]] |publisher=Union of European Football Associations |date=1 May 2022 |access-date=10 May 2022}}</ref>
#Points in head-to-head matches among the tied teams;
#[[Goal difference]] in head-to-head matches among the tied teams;
#Goals scored in head-to-head matches among the tied teams;
#If more than two teams were tied, and after applying all head-to-head criteria above, a subset of teams were still tied, all head-to-head criteria above were reapplied exclusively to this subset of teams;
#Goal difference in all group matches;
#Goals scored in all group matches;
#Away goals scored in all group matches;
#Wins in all group matches;
#Away wins in all group matches;
#Disciplinary points (direct red card = 3 points; double yellow card = 3 points; single yellow card = 1 point);
#[[UEFA coefficient#Men's club coefficient|UEFA club coefficient]].
Due to the abolition of the [[away goals rule]], head-to-head away goals were no longer applied as a tiebreaker starting from last season. However, total away goals were still applied as a tiebreaker.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.uefa.com/news-media/news/026a-1298aeb73a7a-5b64cb68d920-1000--abolition-of-the-away-goals-rule-in-all-uefa-club-competitions/|title=Abolition of the away goals rule in all UEFA club competitions|website=[[UEFA]] |publisher=Union of European Football Associations|date=24 June 2021}}</ref>

==Groups==
The fixtures were announced on 27 August 2022, the day after the draw.<ref>{{cite news|title=All the 2022/23 Europa League fixtures|url=https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuropaleague/news/0278-15f7925dd5ab-06a8b3f47483-1000--2022-23-group-stage-fixtures/|date=27 August 2022|publisher=[[UEFA]]}}</ref> The matches were played on 8 September, 15 September, 6 October, 13 October, 27 October and 3 November 2022. The scheduled kick-off times were 18:45 and 21:00 CET/CEST.

Times are [[Central European Time|CET]]/[[Central European Summer Time|CEST]],{{refn|group=note|[[Central European Summer Time|CEST]] ([[UTC+02:00|UTC+2]]) for dates up to 29 October 2022 (matchdays 1–5), and [[Central European Time|CET]] ([[UTC+01:00|UTC+1]]) for date thereafter (matchday 6).}} as listed by UEFA (local times, if different, are in parentheses).
